metadata.name: Bombable Crawl Spaces
metadata.description:
Ever gone into a crawl space and wanted to bomb your way to the black market? Ever wanted to bomb through that one wall that hides an item behind it? Well, now you can... 50% of the time.
This mod allows you to bomb selective walls in crawl spaces. You can also use Dad's Key, Get out of Jail Free Card, and Soul of Cain in these rooms. Only built-in rooms are currently supported.
Mod Config Menu will let you change the percentage.
This mod requires REPENTOGON.
Update: Better support for black market doors from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3057349799]Crawlspaces Rebuilt[/url] has been added. Doors should now show up immediately, and in non-standard places.
